text: I grew up hearing stories about the platform.
Every version of the story is different.
That makes me think none of them are entirely true.
As a child I tried climbing the restricted sections of the platform.
My father punished me for it.
He seemed more frightened than angry.
I have explored many outer sections of the ruins.
Several passages appear intentionally sealed.
The stonework in those areas differs from the visible parts.
Renu noticed the same thing.
The small ancient shrine contains symbols not found elsewhere.
Renu has copied many of them.
Nobody has successfully translated them.
The platform feels incomplete.
Certain stairways appear to stop abruptly.
I once discovered a blocked doorway beneath a collapsed terrace.
I was unable to clear the debris.
The widow Ila believes hidden chambers exist.
I think she may be right.
Many villagers avoid discussing her husband.
That makes me suspicious.
Nagadatta has shown me several unusual locations in the forest.
Some paths appear older than the village itself.
The Chant performed by the temple changes slightly each year.
Most people never notice.
I asked Nara about it once.
She changed the subject.
My grandfather's old belongings disappeared after his death.
Nobody could explain where they went.
I do not believe that explanation.
